responsibility: Defines rustc’s target-specification subsystem: it owns the `Target`/`TargetOptions` model, linker-flavor and CRT-object infrastructure, JSON loading/serialization, and the ABI registry, then uses shared per-platform base modules (for Apple, Linux, Windows, BSDs, Solaris/illumos, embedded, wasm, and other OS/toolchain families) plus architecture/toolchain helpers to build the full set of built-in target definitions and legacy re-exports across supported CPUs, ABIs, operating systems, and execution environments; companion tests validate ABI-table invariants, Apple-specific construction rules, and cross-target spec consistency and JSON roundtripping.
